youtube_title: Charge Your Phone Only to 80%? Myth or Truth. They're Tricking You #10 #Shorts
youtube_description:
THEY'RE TRICKING YOU #10. People say: stop charging at 80% and the battery lasts longer. A: myth, charge to 100. B: true, 80 is better. Comment!
Answer: B, mostly true. A lithium-ion battery ages faster when it sits at full charge for long and when it gets hot. That's why iPhone has an 80% Limit charging option and Samsung has Battery protection. But don't panic: 100% once in a while is fine. The real enemy is heat, like heavy gaming while charging.
Sources: Apple battery support page; Samsung Battery protection setting.
